table.brief: 会议室预订周视图：时间段为行，周一至周五为列，部分预订跨 2 个时段（rowspan），一个全天活动跨多列

understanding.purpose: 按时间段查看一周内的会议室预订，识别活动、时间和地点。
understanding.reading: 读者先沿左侧时间段定位，再横向比较各日安排；也会纵向查看某一天的预订。跨列活动表示连续多日，跨行活动表示覆盖多个时间段。
groups: 第1列是时间轴，应与各行保持清晰对应。
第2至第6列均为工作日，承担相同的日程展示作用，宽度应具有可比性。
横跨周三至周五的全天活动共享这三列的宽度；跨行活动可利用所覆盖的行高容纳换行。
keep_intact: 日期表头、时间段和会议时间中的数字与标点尽量保持完整。
会议室编号及线上等地点标识应保持完整，并易于与对应活动关联。
跨行或跨列活动的文字应仍能明确对应其覆盖的时间和日期。
may_wrap: 活动名称可按中文自然换行。
活动名称、括号内时间和分隔符后的地点可在彼此之间换行。
已有较高行或跨行单元格可吸收部分换行。

preferred.name: r2A
preferred.note: 以r1C为基础，增加周二列宽以稳定例会时间和地点的排布，并略增周四列宽照顾较长的跨行活动；从其他工作日各借少量宽度，保留相近的列节奏。

acceptable.name: r1B
acceptable.note: 适度加宽时间列，测试时间段的可读性是否改善；五个工作日仍保持相近宽度，观察这一取舍是否值得。

acceptable.name: r1C
acceptable.note: 进一步压缩时间列并让五个工作日完全等宽，测试额外的内容宽度能否减少活动换行，同时检查时间段是否仍易于扫描。

acceptable.name: r2C
acceptable.note: 保留r1C紧凑的时间列和近乎等宽的工作日结构，向周二及周四各增加少量空间，检验能否改善较长活动而不明显削弱其他列。

acceptable.name: r3A
acceptable.note: 以r2A为基础保留较宽的周二，将周四的4px移给周三，尝试改善周三较长活动的换行，同时保持工作日列宽接近。

bad.name: r2B
bad.note: 将时间列增至115px，为94px的单行时间段留足空间；五个工作日维持接近的宽度，检验更清晰的纵向时间轴是否值得活动内容增加换行。
bad.why: The wide time column keeps time ranges on one line, but leaves the day columns cramped. Several bookings break into four or five lines, with room identifiers stranded on their own lines.

bad.name: r3B
bad.note: 保留r2B的单行时间轴，将工作日宽度向周一倾斜，尝试减轻周一跨行评审和研发周会的碎行；用于比较时间轴完整性与活动内容密度的取舍。
bad.why: The wide time column compresses the day columns, producing tall, fragmented bookings and leaving the Friday room identifier alone on a line.

bad.name: r3C
bad.note: 采用介于现有方案之间的时间列宽，给周二更多空间，并保持其余工作日列相近，测试时间轴留白与活动换行之间是否有更好的折中。
bad.why: The time ranges still wrap despite the wider first column, while several bookings become five lines tall and room identifiers are isolated. The extra width buys little visible benefit.

rationale: r2A gives the five weekdays similar visual weight while giving Tuesday enough room for its morning meeting and Thursday enough room for its longer afternoon booking. Its narrow time column consistently wraps time ranges onto two lines, preserving space for the booking details. The resulting rows are comparatively even, and the longest booking occupies three lines.

general: Columns with the same role benefit from similar visual weight, but small width differences can prevent disruptive wrapping.
A wider row-header column is worthwhile when its readability gain outweighs the space taken from the data.
Judge wrapping by whether related details remain easy to scan, not solely by the overall table height.
specific: Tuesday benefits from enough width to keep the morning meeting and its room in two lines.
Thursday benefits from enough width to reduce wrapping in the merged afternoon booking.
Two-line time ranges are consistent in the narrower first column and leave more room for the weekday bookings.

tradeoffs: r3A gives Wednesday more space, but its narrower Thursday column makes the afternoon booking wrap more. A designer who prioritizes single-line time ranges may prefer r2B or r3B despite their more fragmented bookings.
uncertain: The rendered candidates establish the preferred widths but do not establish continuous ranges of equally good widths. The ranges therefore report only the tested preferred values; nearby proportional adjustments may also work.

critique.good: 五个工作日等宽，日期表头保持单行，横向比较容易；跨列和跨行活动的覆盖范围清楚。
critique.problems: 时间段和多项会议时间被拆成多行，周一、周二及跨行活动出现较多短行；多行被最高单元格撑高，留白分布不均。
critique.cause: 时间列109px仍不足以容纳完整时间段；各日122px仅有101px内容宽度，活动名称、时间和地点容易互相挤占。

critique.good: 周三、周四获得较多空间，部分活动的时间和地点更集中，跨行活动的文字也较紧凑。
critique.problems: 周二和周五日期表头换行，表头高度增加；这两列的活动文字也显得拥挤，而相邻日期宽度差异削弱了平日之间的可比性。
critique.cause: 周二、周五各105px，不足以容纳完整日期表头；周三135px、周四145px的增宽来自这两列和时间列。

critique.good: 五个日期表头均为单行，工作日宽度接近，表格整体紧凑；相较r0A，多数活动减少了一行，行与行的节奏更均衡。
critique.problems: 时间段仍在连接符处换行；周一和周二的会议时间分成多行，周三、周四的跨行活动也有较零碎的换行。
critique.cause: 时间列85px只有64px内容宽度；工作日各约127px，虽比r0A稍宽，仍不足以让较长活动的名称、时间和地点同时完整排列。

critique.good: 日期表头完整，工作日列宽接近，便于横向比较。周四较宽，跨行的客户演示内容仍能与其覆盖的时间段对应。
critique.problems: 周二例会被拆成四行，连带拉高上午第一时段；左侧时间段均分成两行。全天活动的地点也折到第二行。
critique.cause: 周二列为122px，可用文字宽度仅101px，容不下例会时间与地点的较好组合；时间列85px不足以容纳单行时间段。

critique.good: 时间列比r1A宽，日期表头完整，工作日列仍有相近的视觉节奏。
critique.problems: 额外分配给时间列的宽度没有让时间段保持单行；周二例会仍为四行并撑高整行。周四跨行活动的名称和时间也较零碎。
critique.cause: 时间列94px扣除边距后只有73px，仍小于时间段所需的94px；周二列仍为122px，周四列从132px缩至128px。

critique.good: 五个工作日等宽，列的角色和比较关系清楚。周二例会比前两版少占一行，使上午第一时段更紧凑；日期表头也都完整。
critique.problems: 时间段仍分成两行，且时间列较窄；部分活动的时间、地点与名称分散在多行。全天活动的地点仍被拆到下一行。
critique.cause: 时间列79px不足以容纳单行时间段；工作日各128px，虽改善了周二例会，但对较长的活动及其时间、地点仍有限制。

critique.good: 工作日列宽接近，日期表头完整；周二稍宽，使周例会和法务咨询的时间、地点组合较紧凑。跨列活动和跨行活动的范围也容易辨认。
critique.problems: 左侧各时间段均断成两行，纵向扫描不够利落；多个活动的起止时间也被拆开。周三和周四的长活动名称及地点排列较拥挤。
critique.cause: 时间列为79px，内容区只有58px，无法容纳完整时间段；工作日列为125–134px，内容区不足以容纳多数完整的会议时间及相邻文字。

critique.good: 115px的时间列使时间段保持单行，左侧时间轴清楚，横向定位容易；五个工作日列的宽度也较均衡。
critique.problems: 活动信息被挤成许多短行，时间和地点经常分离；周三、周四的跨行活动尤其零碎，行高明显增加，整周比较需要更多纵向视线移动。
critique.cause: 时间列比r2A增加36px，留给工作日的宽度减少到119–124px；这些列的内容区仅98–103px，长活动名称和时间因此产生更多换行。

critique.good: 日期表头完整，工作日列宽均衡；周三至周五的跨列活动有充足空间，跨行活动仍能对应其覆盖的时间段。
critique.problems: 时间轴仍逐项断成两行；周二的周例会和法务咨询比r2A更零碎，第二个时间段的行也因此增高。
critique.cause: 时间列仍为79px，完整时间段放不下；周二从r2A的134px缩至130px，少量宽度变化触发了额外换行。

review.method: two fresh-context blind reviews; letters shuffled; includes browser auto layout and equal widths as neutral references

r1C.why: The weekday columns are balanced and all headers fit on one line. Several meeting times and the time-slot labels wrap, but the rows remain reasonably easy to scan.

r2A.why: The weekday headers fit and the slightly wider Tuesday and Thursday columns keep some meeting details together. Time-slot labels and several meeting times still wrap.

r1B.why: All weekday headers fit, but the wider time column does not keep the time slots on one line. The narrower Tuesday column makes the first meeting particularly tall, with its room on a separate line.

ref_auto.why: Friday’s header wraps while its narrow column also breaks several descriptions and room details. The time slots still wrap despite the space given to the first column.

ref_equal.why: Time slots and weekday headers stay on one line, making the schedule structure clear. The narrower day columns force many meeting times and room identifiers onto separate lines, producing tall rows.

r2B.why: Time slots and headers stay intact, and the day columns are fairly balanced. Several meeting times wrap across lines and room identifiers are isolated, making the body dense and tall.

raw.unsure: A is close: its more even weekday widths offer a consistent rhythm, while B keeps a few meeting details together and makes the body slightly shorter.

r1B.why: The weekday headers fit and the columns are reasonably balanced, but several bookings break times and room labels across multiple lines, making rows harder to scan.

ref_auto.why: Friday’s header wraps while the other weekday headers stay on one line. Its narrow column also forces the final booking into three lines, and several times are fragmented.

r1C.why: The weekday headers align on one line and the booking columns have a steady rhythm. Some times still wrap, but the entries and room identifiers remain reasonably easy to scan.

r2B.why: All time-slot labels stay on one line, making the schedule’s row structure clear. The narrower day columns, however, push several room identifiers onto separate lines and make some bookings tall.

r2A.why: The weekday columns are well balanced, with headers on one line and relatively compact bookings. Time-slot labels wrap consistently, though several booking times also break across lines.

ref_equal.why: The time-slot labels stay intact, but the narrower day columns create tall, fragmented bookings, especially on Monday, Wednesday and Thursday.

raw.unsure: C is a close alternative: its columns are similarly balanced, while E gives Tuesday more room and keeps several bookings more compact. D offers clearer time-slot labels at the cost of more wrapping within bookings.

provenance.note: AI visual design judgement; not a human reading study
